svg.title: Across the site-to-site tunnel
svg.desc: vm-azure reaches vm-onprem only through the tunnel, as the VNets are not peered. Its effective route sends the on-prem /20, learned over BGP, to the virtual network gateway; vpngw-azure (AS 65010) and vpngw-onprem (AS 65020) carry it over IPsec with BGP, both connections using one pre-shared key and the same IPsec/IKE policy.
